name: Human resources specialist (redeployment and separation)
description: Prepares a move up or down against one written test, readies the end or pause of an engagement so that access, handover, final pay and surviving obligations are all accounted for, and checks an assignment in another country before it starts.

onet.title: Human Resources Specialists
onet.basis: The role prepares promotions, demotions, separations and assignments against one written test and accounts for access, handover and final pay, which is this occupation's personnel work; matched by the process group's activities against the occupation in O*NET 31.0.
